name: E_perp_E_para_amplitudes
app_psc_label: E_∥ / E_⊥ raw-frame projection amplitudes (Tier 1 raw-frame identity; coordinate-dependent)
tier: Tier 1 (raw-frame algebraic identity from the phi minimal polynomial; coordinate-dependent)

extra.derivation_note: Standard H_4/H_3 cut-and-project amplitudes from the icosahedral projection R^6 → E_∥ ⊕ E_⊥. The ratio E_⊥²/E_∥² = φ⁻² is the raw-frame (coordinate-dependent) ratio reused by the Tier 3 hypothesis H-EW, sin²θ_W^bare = φ⁻³ (V3 Ch04 §4.3; App USS §USS.9). App GRF uses the canonical projector shares 1/2 for Z_1, Z_2. Tier 1: pure algebraic identity from φ² = φ + 1.
